stem:
The function f(x) = -4x + 8 represents the first of two equations in a system of linear equations. The second equation in the system has a different slope than the first equation.

Which statement is true about the solution to the system of equations?

options.label: B
options.text: The system has exactly one solution.

options.label: C
options.text: The system has exactly two solutions.

options.label: D
options.text: The system has infinitely many solutions.
